_comment: A stand-in for the processing host: a PayProbe responder bound to the same Message Format (field table, wire encoding and presence rules land on it from message_format_id) over the same framing, so the scenario runs end to end before the real host is reachable. Save it as a saved simulator (POST /simulator-configs {label, config}), start it, point the connection at it.
description: POS host stand-in — approves everything (DE 39 = 000), echoes PAN / STAN / terminal / currency, issues an RRN and approval code; declines prefix 400000 with 116 (insufficient funds).
